scope: Native controller position-estimate metadata and bounded input history
behavior: Report native aim and grip position estimates independently in animation and historical action frames.
Keep known same-controller ray/grip relationships non-emulated and preserve XRInputSource identity across estimate-quality changes.
Retain protocol-v1 compatibility: omitted metadata fields keep the legacy tracked-pose assumption.
Quality-only changes do not consume bounded transition-history capacity; action snapshots retain their own metadata.

live_samples: Discord login: coherent layout, 30-second survival and clean close
X landing: accepted rendering baseline, 30-second survival and clean close
validation.quality_only_history_baseline: 198 quality-only updates consumed history; corrected unit test retains zero transitions before the actual press/release

deployment: Running sessions are preserved; the updated native producer loads when DomeD is next started.
limitations: Synthetic native transport validation does not establish physical-device or complete API/WPT conformance.
Broader WebXR coverage and later standards-rendering work remain.
